svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.brain-cerebral-cortex-part-focus", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Introduced enlarged local section of folded cerebral cortex: one continuous outer cortical grey-matter ribbon over underlying white matter. Independent local cortical-layer relation, not a whole-brain recognition substitute, a particular lobe, exact APH514fill or medical image. Human cortex is folded grey matter over white matter; other deep grey nuclei exist but are outside this local crop, so do not teach all grey matter is surface cortex. Histological six-layer detail, meninges, vessels, ventricles, cells and disease/functional localisation are omitted. Two broad folds are sample geometry, not a universal human gyrus count. No claim of thicker cortex from larger tactile height. Every actual profile/nominal medium review and physical/learner suitability pending.", "geometry_exception": "Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard. Logical curve/crop joins de-duplicated; optional near-junction samples omitted. Profiles share compatible anatomical boundaries; no Braille or physical recognition result.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphicdots with3.1mm guard. Logical curve/crop endpoints retained once; optional near-junction samples omitted. Cortex remains two continuous sampled boundaries; sand-dollar pore-band pairs stay open. No Braille or actual tactile validation.
